newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank shares extend losses in Tokyo morning.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank shares extend losses in Tokyo morning.

text.p: Shares in Fuji Bank Ltd extended losses in heavy Tokyo morning trade due to worries over bad loan problems afflicting much of the financial sector.

The shares may have been also hurt by the trend among cash-strapped Japanese companies of selling some of their bank and brokerage shareholdings, slowly moving out of Japan's traditional cross-share holding system, brokers said.
The share price of the Japanese city bank was down 40 yen at 1,600 yen at 0135 GMT, after briefly falling as low as 1,570 yen. Its volume was 2.16 million.
